# Kotlin/Native 2.4.21 binary notices

The framework uses the Kotlin/Native runtime and its default memory allocator
on iOS. This directory contains the unmodified release license texts for Kotlin,
Apache Harmony, GWT, Guava, libbacktrace, Unicode and the multi-producer,
multi-consumer bounded queue. The compiler release notice is retained too.
[JetBrains binary distribution requirements](https://kotlinlang.org/docs/native-binary-licenses.html)

The source is available in the
[Kotlin/Native runtime tree](https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin/tree/v2.4.21/kotlin-native/runtime)
and the
[Kotlin 2.4.21 source archive](https://codeload.github.com/JetBrains/kotlin/tar.gz/refs/tags/v2.4.21).
